title: Escape the Pike
specs: Handcrafted escape rooms with high quality tech
No minimum age requirement; parental discretion advised; minors require parent/guardian permission and supervision
Some games have steps and uneven terrain; some wheelchair accessible with advance notice
Games are private bookings; no strangers included
Team sizes vary by game, from 2 to 10 players maximum depending on room

services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: Prof. Perkins is in a dire situation, and he’s relying on you to solve the puzzles he’s left behind. Use your wits and the clues at hand to unravel the mystery and complete the adventure! This escape game is perfect for teams of 3-6 players but we can host up to 8 players. Perfect for escape room players of all ages. There is no minimum age requirement. This experience includes steps and uneven terrain, which may be challenging for those with mobility

gap: Exact prices per game and per number of players not stated
blurb: Guests play private escape room games featuring multi-room play, unique puzzles, and challenging obstacles. Games are themed and suitable for various ages and abilities, with some wheelchair accessible. Game Masters monitor and assist players during the experience.
extraNote: No walk-ins; appointments must be booked in advance · No refunds; cancellations may be rescheduled with notice; gift certificates offered case-by-case · Players must not be intoxicated, destructive, or abusive; right to deny or eject · If weather is unsafe, closure announced on Facebook · Arrive 15 minutes prior to scheduled start time · Located in the rear, right side of the building up the stone steps, accessed by a driveway to the left of Teddy G’s Pub & Grille.
